about: For each luismc plugin that reads another plugin's files: the lowest version of the other plugin it needs. delivery_doctor.py check plugins.compat compares these with the installed plugin cache. Plugins are named, never their folders, so a plugin can move without changing this file.

luismc-artifacts.why: Reads the artifacts registry.json in the record_dir for task statuses.

luismc-docs.why: Reads record_dir from docs/docs.json; join.py calls the luismc-docs scripts (docs_fold.py, docs_check.py).
